summary: Fixed lib/numwords.rb (tests untouched). Three bugs: (1) below_thousand joined tens+ones with a space instead of a hyphen — now "forty-two" (lib/numwords.rb:30); (2) "and" was never emitted — now inserted between "hundred" and the remainder in any group, and prepended to the last group when it has no hundreds (e.g. "two thousand and one"), gated on thousands.positive? so numbers < 1000 stay plain (lib/numwords.rb:20,35-39); (3) ordinal() used only n % 10, giving "11st" — now checks n % 100 for 11/12/13 → "th" first, then n % 10 for st/nd/rd (lib/numwords.rb:44-53). Verified: `ruby -Ilib -Itest test/all_test.rb` → 6 runs, 22 assertions, 0 failures, exit 0.
